idea-plugin.name: DevSnip Pro: REST API Client
idea-plugin.description:
A REST and GraphQL API client inside the IDE, ported from the DevSnip Pro VS Code extension.

  • Send HTTP requests with params, headers and JSON, text, form or GraphQL bodies
  • Bearer, Basic, API key (header or query) and OAuth 2.0 token authentication
  • Environments with {{variables}}; secret variables are kept in the IDE password safe
  • Status, timing, size, headers and formatted JSON responses, with clear error diagnosis
  • Retries with backoff, redirect limits, timeouts, proxy and SSL options, cookies
  • cURL import and export, request history with JSON and CSV export

Open it from View | Tool Windows | DevSnip API.
